context: Hiroshi and Kenji review their financial report.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 健次、収入、本当、伸びてる。
lines.en: Kenji, your numbers are genuinely growing.
lines.style: Measured approval. Direct eye contact. A brief pause after the name — he's pleased. Steady voice, no hurry. The kind of compliment that lands because it's real.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、料金、見直し、効果、出てる。
lines.en: Yes — the fee restructuring is working.
lines.style: Earnest and warm. A small breath before speaking, like he's letting the praise land first. Professional but genuine. Not overthinking it, just grateful to report good news.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: The company is doing well, isn't it.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. A downward inflection that invites agreement without demanding it. Warm underneath — he means it about the whole team, not just the numbers.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 皆で、頑張った、結果、本当に。
lines.en: We all worked hard for this result.
lines.style: Humble but steady. Shoulders slightly loose. He's not deflecting — just making sure credit stays collective. Genuine warmth, no false modesty in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Gentle declaration. Eyes open. Not a command — an invitation. The word 'together' lands softly, like an arm on the shoulder. A promise in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'm truly grateful. Always will be.
lines.style: Soft and sincere. A slight catch in the breath — this matters to him. Not theatrical. Just a moment of real feeling before the word 'always.' Quiet at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Light warmth, steady backbone. A hand on Kenji's shoulder in the voice. Not urgent, not heavy. Just the quiet determination of someone who sees the path ahead and wants him to walk it too.
